title: Hot Corn Fritters Fresh From the Oil - Caught on Camera
body:
Caught my first batch of corn fritters on camera. Look at how golden they are. Listen to that sizzle. ASMR warning.

Ingredients:
- 2 cups corn
- 1 cup flour
- 1 egg
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1 tsp baking powder
- Oil for frying
- Honey for drizzling

Steps:
1. Mix flour, baking powder, salt
2. Add egg and milk
3. Fold in corn kernels
4. Heat oil to 375F
5. Drop spoonfuls into oil
6. Fry until golden, drain on paper towels
summary: First batch of corn fritters caught on camera. Look at how golden they are. ASMR warning.
